mapper.select: SELECT cp.effective_week_tag FROM competitor_products_clean cp WHERE cp.marketplace = #{marketplace} AND cp.effective_week_tag IS NOT NULL AND ( cp.source LIKE '%新品%' OR LOWER(cp.source) LIKE '%new%' ) GROUP BY cp.effective_week_tag ORDER BY MAX(cp.created_at) DESC, cp.effective_week_tag DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM competitor_products_clean cp WHERE

SELECT cp.id, cp.marketplace, cp.asin, cp.parent_asin, cp.dedup_key, cp.month, cp.effective_week_tag, cp.effective_week_tag AS created_week, cp.title, cp.brand, cp.image_url, cp.node_id, cp.node_label_path, cp.bsr_id, cp.units, cp.bsr, cp.price, cp.listing_days, cp.weight_g, cp.rating, cp.ratings, cp.fulfillment, cp.source, cp.product_url, cp.similar_url, cp.created_at FROM competitor_products_clean cp WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN cp.bsr IS NOT NULL AND cp.bsr > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, cp.bsr ASC, cp.units DESC, cp.asin ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT MAX(dz.batch_date) FROM deng_zong_shop dz WHERE dz.marketplace = #{marketplace} AND dz.batch_date IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT dz.asin, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dz.asin ORDER BY dz.created_at DESC, dz.id DESC) AS rn FROM deng_zong_shop dz WHERE ) t WHERE t.rn = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT dz.id, dz.marketplace, dz.asin, dz.parent_asin, NULL AS dedup_key, dz.month, dz.batch_date AS effective_week_tag, dz.batch_date AS created_week, dz.title, dz.brand, dz.image_url, dz.node_id, dz.node_label_path, dz.bsr_id, dz.units, dz.bsr, dz.price, NULL AS listing_days, NULL AS weight_g, dz.rating, dz.ratings, dz.fulfillment, COALESCE(dz.source, '郑总同行') AS source, dz.product_url, dz.similar_url, dz.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dz.asin ORDER BY dz.created_at DESC, dz.id DESC) AS rn FROM deng_zong_shop dz WHERE ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, t.units DESC, CASE WHEN t.bsr IS NULL OR t.bsr <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, t.bsr ASC, t.asin ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
